prize.text: $25,000 for the Series competition (previously Professional) and $5,000 for the Single Image competition (previously Open), plus Sony equipment
prize.quote: you could win $25,000, a solo exhibition, a range of top Sony Digital Imaging equipment ... you could win $5,000, a range of top Sony Digital Imaging equipment

freeEntry.text: Free to enter, by the organiser's own statement
freeEntry.quote: Since the beginning, the Awards have championed inclusivity and access by being free to enter.

deadline.text: 2027 awards: Student closes 2026-11-27 16:00 GMT; Single Image and Youth close 2027-01-05 16:00 GMT; Series closes 2027-01-12 16:00 GMT
deadline.quote: 27 November 2026 16:00 GMT Student competition closes / 5 January 2027 16:00 GMT Single Image and Youth competition close / 12 January 2027 16:00 GMT Series competition closes

eligibility.quote: Entry rules per competition (Student requires enrolment; Youth is under 19). Full eligibility terms sit on each competition page and were not read in this pass.

aiPolicy.quote: The overview page does not state whether AI-generated imagery is accepted; the category rules must be read before entering.

payout.quote: Payment method not described on the overview page.

summary: Free to enter with cash prizes of $25,000 and $5,000 and deadlines in November 2026 and January 2027 - one of the few genuinely free, large, open-to-anyone cash prizes in the ledger.
flags: Requires original photography; AI-generation policy unread.
